liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Sugaree** (2 reviews): Reviewer says the first-set Sugaree smokes; Reviewer calls it the most inspired Sugaree, with three distinct jams forming one long song [5][10]
- **Dancing In The Street** (2 reviews): Reviewer lists Dancing among the first-set highlights, alongside Row Jimmy, Looks Like Rain and Peggy-O; Reviewer says Bobby closes the first set with a Dancin' that rocks the house [5][6]
- **Peggy-O** (1 review): Reviewer calls the Sugaree and Peggy-O stellar versions [7]
- **Passenger** (1 review): Reviewer calls Passenger hot and raunchy, and wonders why the band dropped it [6]
- **Terrapin Station** (1 review): Reviewer says the Terrapin into Playin' and Uncle John's stretch shows the band's collective 1977 jamming [6]
- **Playing In The Band** (1 review): Reviewer praises the cohesion from Terrapin through the end of Playin' [7]

## Setlist highlights

- **Exercise**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [17]

## The recordings

- **gd77-05-19.sbd.direwolf.3120.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 20 songs; 190 min; rated 4.73/5 by 37 [1]
- **gd1977-05-19.139377.sbd.latvala.miller.sirmick.flac1648**: soundboard; 21 songs; 187 min; rated 3.67/5 by 6 [2]. Said about its sound: Tracks were pitch corrected, and small dropouts were repaired using the shnid 3120 source [2]
- **gd1977-05-19.sbd.clugston.2461.sbefail.shnf**: soundboard; 20 songs; 177 min; rated 4.44/5 by 9 [3]. Said about its sound: Most circulating copies have a master reel flip during the Playin' in the Band jam, losing 1:43 [3]
- **gd1977-05-19.sbd.bertha.9394.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 19 songs; 190 min; rated 5/5 by 4 [4]

## Around the show

- Reviewer judges this show better than the previous night's [5]
- Reviewer, agreeing with the Deadhead's Compendium, calls it the best show of May 1977, with no letdowns [7]
- Reviewer says this show beats the 5/9 show, previously their favorite of the year [8]
- Reviewer says all May '77 shows rank very high, but this one stands out as the best [10]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd77-05-19.sbd.direwolf.3120.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [1]. Also: Taken from a 7-inch master reel at 7.5 ips, to CD, EAC, then SHN; seed from Jim Wise, retracked by DireWolf [1]
- **gd1977-05-19.139377.sbd.latvala.miller.sirmick.flac1648**: taped by Dick Latvala; transferred by Charlie Miller and Sir Mick; source: sbd > master reel > dat (48k) from Dick Latvala [2]. Also: Dick's Picks 29 release has a splice in China Doll, with about 48 seconds missing [2]
- **gd1977-05-19.sbd.clugston.2461.sbefail.shnf**: transferred by Scott Clugston; source: Master Soundboard Reel > Reel to Reel > DAT > CDR [3]. Also: Patch for the Playin' gap comes from an alternate soundboard, purportedly from a cassette master; A third soundboard source, MSR to reel to reel to DAT, supplies an 11-second patch in Sugaree [3]
- **gd1977-05-19.sbd.bertha.9394.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Jay Ashley; source: SBD>>MR>>CDA>>WAV(EAC)>>SHN>>DAW(Bertha)>>CDA [4]
